sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B with Unsloth: Run, Quantize, or Fine-Tune
sources.snippet: Yes — Unsloth runs Qwen3.8 27B, and it is the fastest way to get Ali baba's new Apache-2.0 model onto your own GPU. The whole answer in one line: open Unsloth Studio, search "Qwen3.8 27B", pick UD-Q4_K_XL (17.9GB) on a 24GB card, and chat in under a minute. sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.
